title: Northgate+ Membership Fee Schedule
content:
Membership pricing for **Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships**: the fee each tier charges per billing cycle, the length of its paid term, the day renewal fees fall on and the reminder sent ahead of an annual renewal.

| Tier | Fee per billing cycle (USD) | Billing cycle | Paid term (calendar months) | Renewal charge day | Annual renewal reminder (calendar days before renewal) | A change between paid tiers takes effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Rewards | 0.00 | none | 0 | enrollment day | 0 | next renewal date |
| Northgate+ Assist | 6.47 | monthly | 1 | enrollment day | 0 | next renewal date |
| Northgate+ Student | 6.47 | monthly | 1 | enrollment day | 0 | next renewal date |
| Northgate+ Monthly | 12.95 | monthly | 1 | enrollment day | 0 | next renewal date |
| Northgate+ Annual | 98.00 | annual | 12 | enrollment day | 30 | next renewal date |
| Northgate+ Business | 98.00 | annual | 12 | enrollment day | 30 | next renewal date |

**Schedule notes**

1. The fee is the membership fee charged each billing cycle, in US dollars with two decimals; it is 0.00 for the free tier.
2. The billing cycle is none, monthly or annual.
3. The paid term is the length of one paid term in calendar months; it is 0 for the free tier, which has no paid term.
4. Renewal fees are charged on the enrollment day: the calendar day of the term start date, falling back to the last day of a shorter month.
5. The annual renewal reminder is sent the stated number of calendar days before an annual renewal date; it is 0 for tiers not billed annually.

**Reading the charge day (hypothetical dates)**

| Term start date | Renewal charge day in a 31-day month | in a 30-day month | in February |
|---|---|---|---|
| the 10th | the 10th | the 10th | the 10th |
| the 31st | the 31st | the 30th (last day) | the 28th or 29th (last day) |

**Points of reference**

- Northgate+ Assist and Northgate+ Student carry the same fee per monthly cycle, 6.47; Northgate+ Monthly carries 12.95.
- Northgate+ Annual and Northgate+ Business each carry 98.00 per annual cycle over a 12-month term.
- Only the two annual tiers send a renewal reminder ahead of the renewal date, 30 calendar days before it.
